読み取り・確度・再生について

Corno II はF管です。青の記譜音から完全5度下げた実音を橙で併記します。音のプレビューは選択した本線音を合成した単音です。音価候補がある場合だけその拍数を使い、候補がない場合は短い試聴音にします。譜面全体の連続再生は、リズムと休符の完全照合が終わっていないため接続していません。

p11は上部の1楽章7段のみです。下の2楽章 Adagio は今回の譜読みとPDFから除外しました。OMR出力は比較用の候補として扱い、音高・臨時記号は原譜画像と独立した人手監査を優先しています。

  • Three low-grade OMR head detections (m1 n05, m25 n02, m39 n07) align with visible source noteheads and staff positions but remain flagged for a second manual check.
  • A printed “A Viol. I.” cue indication is visible in system 3. Reduced heads there are tagged cue, but the cue’s exact start/end among adjacent full-size Horn II heads should be reviewed before whole-part playback.
  • Reduced heads outside that labeled span are tagged cue_candidate rather than silently treated as Horn II notes.
  • MusicXML duration_quarters remain provisional OMR candidates. The original rhythm glyphs are preserved in the source page; a separate rhythm-by-rhythm pass is still needed for playback-grade timing.
  • Treble clef with 8 below begins at measure 37; the combined builder must apply the octave semantics consistently when computing concert-pitch octaves.
  • Source bar numerals are sparse; candidate local measure 1–96 is not a verified global measure map.
  • The system-1 Cor. III,V / Corno I cue boundary and system-10 Tbe. I (in C) cue endpoint are approximate; all listed cue notes remain excluded pending review.
  • Eight system-4 notes were independently checked at 600 dpi: n001 B3, n004 B3, n005 A4, n006 B3, n007 B3, n008 A4, n009 B3, n010 C4. No key signature or accidental applies; retain source geometry despite OMR candidate disagreements.
  • Systems 6, 8, and 12 have false MusicXML F-clef interpretations; the printed treble clef is used, so MusicXML pitch and duration candidates in those systems are rejected.
  • Durations are candidate-only and omitted from duration_quarters until a separate rhythm-glyph audit.
  • Five nearby altered MusicXML pitch conflicts were checked against the source notehead crops; the altered candidates belong to neighboring pitches, with no accidental glyph at the audited source heads, so they were not transferred.
  • 45 source heads have no pitch-matched MusicXML event; their written pitch is retained from source staff geometry and the mismatch is comparison-only.
  • The first-system page-start key signature remains unresolved. No key signature was applied; all unmarked B pitches include explicit B-natural/B-flat alternatives if one flat is later confirmed.
  • Eight visible D5 heads have no matching MusicXML note event: seven in system 3 (x=1727, 1794, 1912, 1976, 2092, 2161, 2282 px) and one in system 7 (x=2552 px). Their source coordinates and pitches are retained, durations are null, and playback is excluded pending manual rhythm/role review.
  • MusicXML duration values for matched heads remain provisional and need a dedicated rhythm pass before playback authority.
  • No cue-source label could be confirmed within the scoped systems; do not infer a cue source from the OMR omissions.
